audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill'; the content layer reads Akshan x4 then Diana x3, which matches packet.levelChart.
audit.why: 48.95% over 1804 games with a clear flip at level 6: Akshan bullies her before Moonfall, and Diana takes over once the full dive combo exists. The content layer is right and the full layer is unset.
audit.corrected: Full sides set to Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Diana, Diana, Diana.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is garbled ('Avengerang... no —') and calls Akshan's R 'Vengeance'. spikes[3] and the late paragraph describe Diana's R as 'reset-heavy' and say she resets off kills.
audit.why: Diana's R is Moonfall (100/90/80s, 475 range) — a pull and slow. It has no reset. The reset in her kit is Lunar Rush (E): it costs no cooldown when it dashes to a target afflicted with Moonlight from Crescent Strike. Attributing the reset to her ultimate teaches the wrong dodge.
audit.corrected: Level 6 phase rewritten to Moonfall's 475-range pull. Reset correctly credited to Lunar Rush off the Moonlight mark, with the 22-second unmarked cooldown given as the punish window.
sources: enemyKit E text ('Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight')

audit.whatIsWrong: The early paragraph claims 'Her passive shield only procs off ability hits'. Diana's passive is Moonsilver Blade — a third-strike cleave plus attack speed after casting a spell. It grants no shield.
audit.why: The shield is Pale Cascade (W), 15/13.5/12/10.5/9s, whose three orbiting spheres must detonate on an enemy, and the shield is strengthened only if the third sphere detonates. That is a real spacing lever the page mis-assigns: stay off her and the orbs expire without hitting anything, so she gets the base shield or none.
audit.corrected: Shield correctly named as Pale Cascade (W) with its 15s rank-1 cooldown and the orb-contact condition stated. Also carried the missingInteractions point: hold Heroic Swing for her Lunar Rush engage rather than spending it on poke.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Crescent Strike' in wants.foe[0] as a probable wrong name. It is Diana's real Q name. False positive — no edit.

edits.before: Avengerang... no — R online: Vengeance executes the chipped from two screens. Chip, then channel.
edits.after: Her level 6: Moonfall drags you in from 475 and Lunar Rush follows. Stay outside that circle.

edits.before: Diana wins by landing Crescent Strike, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Diana wins by marking you with Crescent Strike, because Lunar Rush then costs her no cooldown and the dash keeps arriving until you die.

edits.before: Ahead, bully harder: string Diana off every contact, swing-roam the rivers, and execute the map's mistakes with R.
edits.after: Ahead, keep her beyond 900 range: unmarked, Lunar Rush is a 22-second spell and she owns no other way to reach you.

edits.before: Carry through strings and executes — chip everything, finish anything under a third, and let the swing write angles no one wards.
edits.after: Carry by never wearing Moonlight when she is close — sidestep the arc and both her 22s dash and her 475-range Moonfall stay useless.

edits.before: If Diana takes first blood, tighten up: Crescent Strike is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q strings and stay relevant through R executes.
edits.after: If Diana takes first blood, tighten up: one Crescent Strike now buys her a free dash and the kill. Farm at 850 with Q, bank Heroic Swing purely for her jump-in, and stay relevant through Comeuppance executes.

edits.before: Diana relies entirely on landing Crescent Strike to start her combo, and without it she has no reliable engage, so you can freely punish her missed skillshots with E-Q pressure. Her passive shield only procs off ability hits, meaning clean auto-trades from you go mostly unanswered. Bait a Crescent Strike into minions, then walk her down while it's on cooldown.
edits.after: Diana needs Crescent Strike to mark you before Lunar Rush becomes free, and without the mark her dash is a 22-second spell, so you can punish every miss with Q strings. Her shield is Pale Cascade (W) on a 15-second cooldown, and its orbs have to actually touch you — hold your spacing and she gets little or none of it. Bait the arc into minions, then walk her down.

edits.before: Diana becomes a dive-and-reset threat in teamfights, jumping onto your backline with Lunar Rush and resetting off any kill, which your kit struggles to answer in a straight fight. Your best play is isolating her with R before she can jump into a fight, since once she's engaged with resets available she's very hard to peel off. Vision on her position pre-fight is critical.
edits.after: Diana becomes a dive threat in teamfights: Crescent Strike marks your backline and Lunar Rush then costs her nothing to reach it, which your kit struggles to answer straight-up. Your best play is executing her with Comeuppance before she jumps, since once Moonfall has dragged your team together she is very hard to peel off her target. Vision on her position pre-fight is critical.

edits.before: Diana's dive-the-backline teamfight kit and reset-heavy R make her a premier late-game threat — your only real answer is picking her off with R before she jumps in.
edits.after: Diana's dive-the-backline kit and her 475-range Moonfall pull make her a premier late-game threat — your only real answer is executing her with R before she jumps in.

edits.before: Dive with R resets in teamfights past 6
edits.after: Dive with Moonfall pulling your team in

notes: Two real errors corrected. (1) The page credited Diana's ultimate with resets ('reset-heavy R', 'resetting off any kill'); the reset belongs to Lunar Rush, which costs no cooldown when dashing to a Moonlight-marked target, and Moonfall is a 475-range pull with no reset at all. (2) The early paragraph said 'her passive shield' — Diana's passive is Moonsilver Blade (third-strike cleave, attack speed after a cast); the shield is Pale Cascade (W). packet.suspectNames flagged 'Crescent Strike' as a wrong name; it is correct, false positive. Full-layer level chart was unset ('Skill') on all seven rows while the content layer already matched the packet; proposed as one atomic group on the full side. Left breakdown.mid and breakdown.wave templated — Diana's kit adds nothing wave-specific beyond what breakdown.early now says, and I would have had to invent it.
